title: Propose-Filter-Release: Scaling Noise to Typical Sensitivity via Private Filtering
review: An estimator can be accurate and stable on typical data, yet sensitive to a few possible records. Differentially private mechanisms commonly scale their noise to the worst-case influence of a single record, which lets these records dictate the noise even when the remaining data would allow far less.
